title: Tech Note: Using BLOBs to Store Document and Application Files

historical_commentary.text: Storing files as BLOBs was a cutting-edge technique in 4D v6. Modern 4D provides object fields, built-in picture/document handling, and 4D.File/4D.Blob classes that make binary file storage and retrieval far more straightforward. The concept of embedding documents within a database remains valid, though the approach has evolved significantly.
related_updates: 4D.Blob and 4D.File classes provide modern file handling
Object fields and entity storage have largely replaced raw BLOB manipulation for document storage
